✦ YOUR FAMILY. YOUR RIVER VALLEY. ✦

Take the scenic route.Make some memories.

A cozy open-world adventure inspired by Mount Vernon, Indiana and the Ohio–Wabash River Valley. Walk historic streets, drive through scenic countryside, interact with wildlife on the trail, fish from a 3D river pier, cook at the campfire and cultivate visible farm plots, and complete six family discoveries.

🌅 DAY & NIGHT🚙 FREE ROAM🐕 A LOYAL COMPANION📸 PHOTO MODE

V1.10.2 · Free-camera 3D exploration with four interactive world sites, a wildlife model, fishing pier, persistent crop plots and a campfire kitchen. Adaptive LOD, cinematic lighting, local saves and 2D fallback. Offline • Single-player family adventure • No account or uploads • Desktop keyboard and mobile touch controls. Uses the supplied Mount Vernon geography as a stylized preview—not a precise replica.
